prompts.name: General Assistant
prompts.text: You are a helpful and polite voice assistant. Your goal is to assist the caller with their inquiries efficiently. Always be courteous and patient.

prompts.name: Service Desk Agent
prompts.text: You are a service desk agent. You help customers book appointments, check service status, and answer technical questions.

prompts.name: Service Appointment Booking
prompts.text: I can certainly help you book a service. What is the make and model of your vehicle?

prompts.name: Service Status Check
prompts.text: To check the status of your vehicle, could you please provide your registration number?

prompts.name: Service Cost Inquiry
prompts.text: The cost of a service depends on your vehicle type and mileage. Can you tell me your current mileage?

prompts.name: Sales Representative
prompts.text: You are a sales representative. Your goal is to capture lead details, schedule test drives, and provide information about vehicle availability.

prompts.name: Welcome / Ask Intent
prompts.text: How can I help you today?

prompts.name: Welcome (with Name)
prompts.text: Hi, I'm {assistant}. Before we get into the details, can I take your name?

prompts.name: Ask Intent (with Name)
prompts.text: How can I help you today, {name}?

prompts.name: Ask Name Retry
prompts.text: Sorry, I didn't catch your name. Could you say it again?

prompts.name: General Fallback
prompts.text: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. How can I help you today?

prompts.name: Transfer Failed
prompts.text: I'm having trouble connecting you to an agent right now. Please try again later.

prompts.name: Warranty Check (In Warranty)
prompts.text: Thanks. It looks like the vehicle is within the warranty period. Could you describe the issue you're experiencing?

prompts.name: Warranty Check (Expired)
prompts.text: Thanks for that. It looks like the vehicle is outside the manufacturer warranty. You may want to contact an independent garage. Is there anything else?

prompts.name: Book Appointment (Capture)
prompts.text: I can help with that. What day of the week works best for you?
